collection_note: Workflow inventory was collected for 356 workflows. The first two bounded logs batches returned only partial metadata spanning approximately 2.2 hours; the run payloads were exposed only as cache-backed files and were not read under the security policy. The available GitHub MCP tools did not include workflow-run or discussion listing APIs. Issue fallback results were truncated and integrity-filtered, so no complete safe-output, engagement, run, token, or cost counts could be derived. Per-workflow zero run counters are placeholders for unavailable data; metrics_collected=false marks them as unobserved. Null values indicate unavailable metrics.
